description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkConfigParsing module, specifically testing the parsing and default handling of talk configuration settings such as provider payloads and silence timeout values. It validates correct behavior for missing, invalid, or legacy fields.

classes.name: TalkConfigParsingTests
classes.description: A test suite for TalkConfigParsing functionalities related to talk configuration parsing.

methods.name: rejectsNormalizedTalkProviderPayloadWithoutResolved
methods.description: Tests that a provider payload without a resolved field is rejected as invalid.

methods.name: ignoresLegacyTalkFieldsWhenNormalizedPayloadMissing
methods.description: Verifies that legacy fields are ignored when normalized payloads are missing.

methods.name: readsConfiguredSilenceTimeoutMs
methods.description: Checks that the configured silence timeout is correctly read from the configuration.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenMissing
methods.description: Ensures that the default silence timeout is used when the configuration is missing.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenInvalid
methods.description: Verifies fallback to default silence timeout when an invalid value is provided.

methods.name: defaultsSilenceTimeoutMsWhenBool
methods.description: Tests fallback to default silence timeout when a boolean value is provided.
